title: F&A Creator SMP Public Pack
description: This is the pack for the Fossils and Archeology Official Creator SMP that we are releasing for the public to play in your own worlds and with your friends! We hope you enjoy it. We recommend 6GB of ram when playing.
body:
This project is for the public release of the Official Fossils and Archeology SMP Modpack.

![Logo for the Official Fossils SMP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d915358f21dd996e86bcd2735fffd80b483ae8a4.png)

You can create your own worlds and play with your friends with the same mods as the creators play with, all with a central point of [Fossils and Archeology: Revival](https://modrinth.com/mod/fossils-and-archeology-revival). This has been made possible by optimizing the heck out of the pack, allowing for playing at as low as 2GB of RAM on some systems! 

There are quite the few things to explore alongside the main mod, including create and some of its addons, ad astra for an intersting space based raptor to bring home from the martian surface, and many many other mods that add bunches of building blocks to make your parks and enclosure look as pretty as you want!

For this pack, we personally recommend a setting of 6GB of RAM, and to not go higher than 12.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the public [Discord](https://discord.gg/kD2kgan2c7)!
